addon.certifications.meta.name: Certifications
addon.certifications.meta.description: Issue printable, verifiable completion certificates to players - adds its own Certifications tab and view. Branding (org name/logo/signature/accent color) is configurable from the gear button; the platform's own backend (server/app.py) stores and verifies certificates.
addon.certifications.config.always_shown: Every certificate also always shows an "Issued & verifiable via OpenCTF" line, regardless of the branding above.
